kw.doc: One invoice end-to-end with 60-second SAP step timeout. A SAP / technical failure is tried ONCE more straight away (clean screen); if it fails again it is recorded (with a note) and the loop continues. Data problems and errors while saving are never retried. If a SAP step hangs for SAP_STEP_TIMEOUT seconds, SAP is closed and the invoice is marked FAILED so the next run can retry.
Normal run: process all MATCHED invoices. When none found: close SAP, wait, check again, reopen only if MATCHED found.

suite.doc:
KTFL - MIRO invoice entry robot
Picks invoices with status = MATCHED from PostgreSQL (written by the invoice extractor) and enters them in MIRO: 1. Basic data: date, reference -> PO -> then Calculate tax, Tax code (invoices.tax_code), Business Place + Section, Text (first line item) 2. Tick ONLY rows whose "Reference Document" = invoice GRN -> HSN/SAC of those rows = DB HSN (changed in the cell if different) 3. Amount = invoice total -> balance 0? else Details tab: Doc. Type by plant, Unpl. Del. Csts = balance 4. Simulate -> CHECK: exit | PARK: park | POST: post
MIRO_MODE = CHECK (default, nothing saved) | PARK | POST Run: run_miro.bat or robot --outputdir output tasks\miro_posting.robot
Variables (optional, passed via CLI): -v REQUEUE_INVOICE_ID:123 process only invoice id=123 (dashboard re-queue) -v SAP_STEP_TIMEOUT:60 seconds before a hanging SAP step is aborted
